properties.title: Powell's first Green–Colorado expedition
properties.why_famous: The first recorded complete boat descent of the Green and Colorado canyons through the Grand Canyon by a U.S. scientific party.
properties.route_summary: Green River, Wyoming → Green River canyons → Colorado confluence → Grand Canyon → St. Thomas, Nevada.
properties.source_title: National Park Service — John Wesley Powell
properties.geometry_note: Named canyon and confluence anchors trace the pre-dam river corridor. Lake Flaming Gorge, Lake Powell, and Lake Mead now obscure major reaches; interpolated lines do not recover the 1869 channel.
properties.description: Named canyon and confluence anchors trace the pre-dam river corridor. Lake Flaming Gorge, Lake Powell, and Lake Mead now obscure major reaches; interpolated lines do not recover the 1869 channel.
properties.overview: The first recorded complete boat descent of the Green and Colorado canyons through the Grand Canyon by a U.S. scientific party.

properties.title: Orellana's Amazon descent
properties.why_famous: The first recorded European voyage from the Amazon headwaters to the Atlantic, documented by expedition chronicler Gaspar de Carvajal.
properties.route_summary: Napo/Curaray vicinity → Napo → Solimões/Amazon → Atlantic mouth.
properties.source_title: Museo de América — Proyecto Amazonas
properties.geometry_note: The upper Napo start, 1542 channel, island passages, and exact Atlantic outlet are uncertain. Named modern confluences provide a broad corridor only.
properties.description: The upper Napo start, 1542 channel, island passages, and exact Atlantic outlet are uncertain. Named modern confluences provide a broad corridor only.
properties.overview: The first recorded European voyage from the Amazon headwaters to the Atlantic, documented by expedition chronicler Gaspar de Carvajal.

properties.title: Marquette–Jolliet Mississippi journey
properties.why_famous: Their account traced much of the Mississippi for France, building on longstanding Indigenous knowledge of its waterways.
properties.route_summary: Lake Michigan → Fox–Wisconsin portage → Mississippi to Arkansas River vicinity → Illinois River return.
properties.source_title: National Park Service — River of History
properties.geometry_note: Portage and return are separate legs. River junctions are supported historically, while seventeenth-century channels and precise canoe tracks are not.
properties.description: Portage and return are separate legs. River junctions are supported historically, while seventeenth-century channels and precise canoe tracks are not.
properties.overview: Their account traced much of the Mississippi for France, building on longstanding Indigenous knowledge of its waterways.

properties.title: La Salle's Mississippi descent
properties.why_famous: La Salle reached the Gulf of Mexico and claimed the Mississippi basin for France as Louisiana.
properties.route_summary: Illinois River country → Mississippi → Gulf of Mexico.
properties.source_title: National Park Service — La Salle and Louisiana
properties.geometry_note: The river course is anchored by known confluences and settlements. Exact 1682 channels and the party's distributary through the delta are unresolved.
properties.description: The river course is anchored by known confluences and settlements. Exact 1682 channels and the party's distributary through the delta are unresolved.
properties.overview: La Salle reached the Gulf of Mexico and claimed the Mississippi basin for France as Louisiana.

properties.title: Fulton's North River Steamboat
properties.why_famous: Its New York to Albany service made steam propulsion commercially credible on the Hudson River.
properties.route_summary: New York City → Livingston estate at Clermont → Albany → return.
properties.source_title: Smithsonian — Fulton's firsthand account
properties.geometry_note: Documented terminals and river towns; exact 1807 ferry channel and landing at Clermont are approximate.
properties.description: Documented terminals and river towns; exact 1807 ferry channel and landing at Clermont are approximate.
properties.overview: Its New York to Albany service made steam propulsion commercially credible on the Hudson River.

properties.title: Lewis and Clark's Missouri–Columbia journey
properties.why_famous: The federally backed expedition crossed North America to the Pacific and kept detailed journals and maps.
properties.route_summary: St. Louis → Missouri River → continental divide portage → Clearwater, Snake, Columbia → Pacific coast.
properties.source_title: National Park Service — Lewis and Clark journey
properties.geometry_note: Outbound route only. River anchors trace a well documented sequence, but meanders, portages, and channel alignments are simplified.
properties.description: Outbound route only. River anchors trace a well documented sequence, but meanders, portages, and channel alignments are simplified.
properties.overview: The federally backed expedition crossed North America to the Pacific and kept detailed journals and maps.

properties.title: Stanley's Lualaba–Congo descent
properties.why_famous: The expedition demonstrated that the Lualaba drained west into the Congo and followed it toward the Atlantic.
properties.route_summary: Nyangwe → Lualaba → Kisangani/Stanley Falls → middle Congo → Pool Malebo → lower Congo → Atlantic.
properties.source_title: Library of Congress — Through the Dark Continent
properties.geometry_note: This is a broad named-river reconstruction. Rapids, forced carries, uncertain nineteenth-century channels, and contested local place names prevent a precise track.
properties.description: This is a broad named-river reconstruction. Rapids, forced carries, uncertain nineteenth-century channels, and contested local place names prevent a precise track.
properties.overview: The expedition demonstrated that the Lualaba drained west into the Congo and followed it toward the Atlantic.

properties.title: Roosevelt–Rondon River of Doubt expedition
properties.why_famous: Roosevelt and Rondon charted a little known Amazon tributary during a dangerous downstream expedition.
properties.route_summary: Rio da Dúvida headwaters → Rio Roosevelt → Aripuanã confluence.
properties.source_title: Library of Congress — Roosevelt–Rondon guide
properties.geometry_note: The upper river's exact launch and 1914 camps are not georeferenced here. Broad waypoints indicate the surveyed corridor through central Amazonia, not observed positions.
properties.description: The upper river's exact launch and 1914 camps are not georeferenced here. Broad waypoints indicate the surveyed corridor through central Amazonia, not observed positions.
properties.overview: Roosevelt and Rondon charted a little known Amazon tributary during a dangerous downstream expedition.

properties.title: Humboldt–Bonpland Orinoco/Casiquiare circuit
properties.why_famous: The journey documented the natural Casiquiare water connection between the Orinoco and Amazon basins.
properties.route_summary: Apure → Orinoco → Atabapo → Rio Negro → Casiquiare → upper Orinoco.
properties.source_title: Humboldt digital edition — 1800 itinerary
properties.geometry_note: The documented circuit is reconstructed at named confluences. Remote side channels and nineteenth-century river courses are approximate.
properties.description: The documented circuit is reconstructed at named confluences. Remote side channels and nineteenth-century river courses are approximate.
properties.overview: The journey documented the natural Casiquiare water connection between the Orinoco and Amazon basins.

properties.title: La Condamine's Amazon survey
properties.why_famous: La Condamine's scientific descent produced a longitude based map of the navigable Amazon.
properties.route_summary: Jaén/Borja → Marañón/Amazon → Pará/Belém → Atlantic transfer toward Cayenne.
properties.source_title: Bibliothèque nationale de France — La Condamine map
properties.geometry_note: Amazon riverway anchored by named towns and tributary junctions; eighteenth-century channels and the transfer from the Amazon mouth to Cayenne are approximate.
properties.description: Amazon riverway anchored by named towns and tributary junctions; eighteenth-century channels and the transfer from the Amazon mouth to Cayenne are approximate.
properties.overview: La Condamine's scientific descent produced a longitude based map of the navigable Amazon.

properties.title: Pedro Teixeira's Amazon ascent and return
properties.why_famous: The Portuguese expedition traversed the Amazon from Pará toward the Andes and returned, extending colonial knowledge and claims.
properties.route_summary: Pará/Belém → Amazon → Napo → Quito region → return to Pará.
properties.source_title: Library of Congress — Portugal country study
properties.geometry_note: The full expedition's land route to Quito and river courses are simplified. Historic distributaries and return path are not recoverable from these city anchors.
properties.description: The full expedition's land route to Quito and river courses are simplified. Historic distributaries and return path are not recoverable from these city anchors.
properties.overview: The Portuguese expedition traversed the Amazon from Pará toward the Andes and returned, extending colonial knowledge and claims.

properties.title: Mackenzie's Arctic river journey
properties.why_famous: Mackenzie reached the Arctic Ocean by the great northern river that later took his name.
properties.route_summary: Fort Chipewyan → Lake Athabasca → Slave River → Great Slave Lake → Mackenzie/Dehcho → Arctic delta → return.
properties.source_title: Smithsonian Libraries — Mackenzie and Dene account
properties.geometry_note: Lakes, Slave River, Mackenzie/Dehcho, and return are distinct legs. Delta distributary and eighteenth-century camp positions remain uncertain.
properties.description: Lakes, Slave River, Mackenzie/Dehcho, and return are distinct legs. Delta distributary and eighteenth-century camp positions remain uncertain.
properties.overview: Mackenzie reached the Arctic Ocean by the great northern river that later took his name.

properties.title: David Thompson's Columbia passage
properties.why_famous: Thompson followed the Columbia to its Pacific mouth and mapped a major transcontinental trade waterway.
properties.route_summary: Kootenae House → overland to Kettle Falls → Columbia to Fort Astoria → river return to Boat Encampment.
properties.source_title: Parks Canada — David Thompson route guide
properties.geometry_note: Parks Canada identifies an overland approach from Kootenae House to the Columbia in present Washington. Approximate land waypoints and named river towns mark the corridor; reservoirs have submerged historical reaches.
properties.description: Parks Canada identifies an overland approach from Kootenae House to the Columbia in present Washington. Approximate land waypoints and named river towns mark the corridor; reservoirs have submerged historical reaches.
properties.overview: Thompson followed the Columbia to its Pacific mouth and mapped a major transcontinental trade waterway.

properties.title: Simon Fraser's Fraser River descent
properties.why_famous: Fraser and his party traversed the formidable canyon of the river later named for him, reaching its Pacific mouth.
properties.route_summary: Fort George/Prince George → Fraser Canyon → Fraser Delta → return.
properties.source_title: Parks Canada — Simon Fraser history
properties.geometry_note: River course follows present named reaches and settlements. Historic canyon passages, tidal delta branches, and the upriver return are schematic.
properties.description: River course follows present named reaches and settlements. Historic canyon passages, tidal delta branches, and the upriver return are schematic.
properties.overview: Fraser and his party traversed the formidable canyon of the river later named for him, reaching its Pacific mouth.

properties.title: French Mekong exploration commission
properties.why_famous: The commission mapped the Mekong basin and showed that its cataracts frustrated hopes of a continuous trade route to China.
properties.route_summary: Saigon → Cambodia and Mekong → Laos → Yunnan overland → Red/Yangtze rivers → Shanghai.
properties.source_title: BnF — Mekong expedition itinerary map
properties.geometry_note: The mission changed modes repeatedly. Lower Mekong, upper Mekong, overland Yunnan, and Yangtze legs are separated; exact 1860s channels and inland paths remain approximate.
properties.description: The mission changed modes repeatedly. Lower Mekong, upper Mekong, overland Yunnan, and Yangtze legs are separated; exact 1860s channels and inland paths remain approximate.
properties.overview: The commission mapped the Mekong basin and showed that its cataracts frustrated hopes of a continuous trade route to China.

properties.title: Livingstone's Zambezi and Shire expedition
properties.why_famous: The expedition surveyed the Zambezi and Shire river systems as possible routes into inland southeast Africa.
properties.route_summary: Zambezi delta → lower Zambezi → Shire River → Lake Nyasa, with multiple excursions.
properties.source_title: Library of Congress — Narrative of an Expedition to the Zambesi
properties.geometry_note: The expedition made repeated trips; this is a representative connected river and lake itinerary, not a single continuous voyage. Delta and Shire channels are approximate.
properties.description: The expedition made repeated trips; this is a representative connected river and lake itinerary, not a single continuous voyage. Delta and Shire channels are approximate.
properties.overview: The expedition surveyed the Zambezi and Shire river systems as possible routes into inland southeast Africa.

properties.title: Mungo Park's final Niger expedition
properties.why_famous: Park's attempt to follow the Niger to the sea ended at the rapids near Bussa.
properties.route_summary: Upper Niger near Bamako → Timbuktu bend → downstream to Bussa.
properties.source_title: Library of Congress — Nigeria country study
properties.geometry_note: Surviving accounts establish major reaches and the Bussa endpoint but not an exact 1805–06 track. The broad Niger bend is reconstructed with modern place anchors.
properties.description: Surviving accounts establish major reaches and the Bussa endpoint but not an exact 1805–06 track. The broad Niger bend is reconstructed with modern place anchors.
properties.overview: Park's attempt to follow the Niger to the sea ended at the rapids near Bussa.

properties.title: Richard and John Lander's Niger descent
properties.why_famous: The brothers' downstream voyage established the Niger's outlet through its delta to the Gulf of Guinea.
properties.route_summary: Bussa → Niger → Nun River distributary → Atlantic.
properties.source_title: Royal Geographical Society — Richard Lander
properties.geometry_note: The river and delta route is anchored at modern towns. The nineteenth-century delta distributary and exact ocean exit are approximate.
properties.description: The river and delta route is anchored at modern towns. The nineteenth-century delta distributary and exact ocean exit are approximate.
properties.overview: The brothers' downstream voyage established the Niger's outlet through its delta to the Gulf of Guinea.

properties.title: Zebulon Pike's upper Mississippi reconnaissance
properties.why_famous: Pike led an early U.S. military survey up the upper Mississippi after the Louisiana Purchase.
properties.route_summary: St. Louis → upper Mississippi → Little Falls vicinity → return.
properties.source_title: National Park Service — Pike expedition history
properties.geometry_note: Upper river itinerary follows known settlements; 1805 side channels and the expedition's farthest northern boat point are approximate.
properties.description: Upper river itinerary follows known settlements; 1805 side channels and the expedition's farthest northern boat point are approximate.
properties.overview: Pike led an early U.S. military survey up the upper Mississippi after the Louisiana Purchase.

properties.title: J. C. Ives's Colorado steamboat survey
properties.why_famous: Ives's steamboat survey and subsequent land work mapped the lower Colorado and the Grand Canyon region.
properties.route_summary: Gulf of California → Colorado River mouth → lower Colorado → Black Canyon vicinity → overland Grand Canyon survey.
properties.source_title: Library of Congress — Ives expedition map
properties.geometry_note: The upstream steamboat limit and land survey are separate. Lower Colorado has been heavily altered by dams and diversions; the historic channel is schematic.
properties.description: The upstream steamboat limit and land survey are separate. Lower Colorado has been heavily altered by dams and diversions; the historic channel is schematic.
properties.overview: Ives's steamboat survey and subsequent land work mapped the lower Colorado and the Grand Canyon region.

properties.title: Henry Hudson's Half Moon river ascent
properties.why_famous: Hudson's Dutch sponsored voyage made a famous early European survey of the river later named for him.
properties.route_summary: New York Bay → Hudson estuary → Albany vicinity → return.
properties.source_title: National Park Service — Hudson River Valley
properties.geometry_note: The vessel's turnaround near present Albany is historically broad; estuary channel and anchorage positions are approximate.
properties.description: The vessel's turnaround near present Albany is historically broad; estuary channel and anchorage positions are approximate.
properties.overview: Hudson's Dutch sponsored voyage made a famous early European survey of the river later named for him.

properties.title: Champlain's Ottawa River journey
properties.why_famous: Champlain's journey helped document a longstanding Indigenous travel corridor between the St. Lawrence and upper Ottawa.
properties.route_summary: Montréal → Ottawa River → Chenaux portage and Muskrat Lake → Morrison Island near Allumette Lake.
properties.source_title: Parks Canada — Champlain route history
properties.geometry_note: A Parks Canada historical study traces the 1613 detour through small lakes to Muskrat Lake and Morrison Island. These lake and portage waypoints are approximate; the route follows a longstanding Indigenous waterway.
properties.description: A Parks Canada historical study traces the 1613 detour through small lakes to Muskrat Lake and Morrison Island. These lake and portage waypoints are approximate; the route follows a longstanding Indigenous waterway.
properties.overview: Champlain's journey helped document a longstanding Indigenous travel corridor between the St. Lawrence and upper Ottawa.

properties.title: Sultana's final Mississippi voyage
properties.why_famous: An overloaded steamboat exploded north of Memphis in the deadliest U.S. maritime disaster.
properties.route_summary: Vicksburg → Memphis → explosion site north of Memphis; intended Cairo/St. Louis not mapped.
properties.source_title: National Park Service — Sultana history
properties.geometry_note: Documented origin, Memphis stop, and explosion reach. The 1865 main channel and precise wreck location shifted over time.
properties.description: Documented origin, Memphis stop, and explosion reach. The 1865 main channel and precise wreck location shifted over time.
properties.overview: An overloaded steamboat exploded north of Memphis in the deadliest U.S. maritime disaster.

properties.title: Robert E. Lee versus Natchez steamboat race
properties.why_famous: The New Orleans to St. Louis contest became the most celebrated Mississippi steamboat race.
properties.route_summary: New Orleans → Baton Rouge → Natchez → Vicksburg → Memphis → St. Louis.
properties.source_title: Library of Congress — contemporary race print
properties.geometry_note: Race endpoints and major ports are known; routes through nineteenth-century cutoffs, bends, and the vessels' separate stops are not resolved.
properties.description: Race endpoints and major ports are known; routes through nineteenth-century cutoffs, bends, and the vessels' separate stops are not resolved.
properties.overview: The New Orleans to St. Louis contest became the most celebrated Mississippi steamboat race.

properties.title: Franklin's Coppermine River expedition
properties.why_famous: Franklin's Arctic survey followed the Coppermine to Coronation Gulf and became notorious for its disastrous return.
properties.route_summary: Fort Enterprise → Coppermine River → Coronation Gulf → Point Turnagain → Arctic Sound and Hood River → overland via Point Lake to Fort Enterprise.
properties.source_title: Royal Museums Greenwich — Franklin expedition archive
properties.geometry_note: The sea passage follows broad coastal waypoints; Point Turnagain uses the expedition's approximate plotted position. The return crossed to Hood River, then went overland via Point Lake, rather than retracing the Coppermine. Remote river, coast, and portage corridors are schematic.
properties.description: The sea passage follows broad coastal waypoints; Point Turnagain uses the expedition's approximate plotted position. The return crossed to Hood River, then went overland via Point Lake, rather than retracing the Coppermine. Remote river, coast, and portage corridors are schematic.
properties.overview: Franklin's Arctic survey followed the Coppermine to Coronation Gulf and became notorious for its disastrous return.
